title: Which Attack on Titan character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Attack on Titan quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Eren, Mikasa, Armin, Levi, Erwin, Hange, Jean or Sasha. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Attack on Titan character are you?
lede: Driven like Eren, loyal like Mikasa or ruthless like Levi? Answer 12 questions about how you fight, plan and treat your friends to find your Survey Corps match.
about: Attack on Titan follows a group of young soldiers living behind giant walls, fighting man-eating Titans and slowly uncovering the truth about their world. Its characters are what keep fans coming back: Eren's burning drive for freedom, Mikasa's quiet loyalty, Armin's strategic mind, Levi's cold skill, Erwin's devotion to the cause, Hange's wild curiosity, Jean's blunt honesty and Sasha's big appetite and bigger heart. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. There are no story spoilers in the questions. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hajime Isayama, Kodansha or the anime's producers; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Eren Yeager, Mikasa Ackerman, Armin Arlert, Levi, Erwin Smith, Hange Zoë, Jean Kirstein and Sasha Blouse.
No. The questions are everyday situations, and the results describe each character's personality without plot twists.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: Someone tells you that you can't do something. You…
options: Do it anyway, louder
Stay calm and quietly prove them wrong
Work out a cleverer way to do it
Do it perfectly and say nothing

items.q: Your role in a group project:
options: The one with the vision everyone follows
The one who asks a hundred questions and loves it
The one who complains, then does the work
The one who brings snacks for everyone

items.q: You find a mysterious locked box. You…
options: Grumble that it's risky, then help open it anyway
Try to force it open right now
Ask what it means for the bigger plan
Study the lock until you understand it

items.q: Your idea of a clean room:
options: Spotless, or it doesn't count
Covered in notes and half-finished experiments
Tidy enough that your friend is comfortable
Wherever the food is, it's fine
Finding the best food in town
Charging off to explore somewhere no one has been
A party where you end up giving the speech
Training, then checking on the people you love

items.q: A friend makes a big mistake. You…
options: Get excited about what you can learn from it
Talk it through and help them find a new plan
Tell them straight, then help them clean up
Remind them why the mission still matters
Inspiring people to give everything for a cause
Making people laugh when things are hard
Never giving up on what you want
Staying cool under pressure
Letting your friends down because you weren't smart enough
Not being taken seriously as a leader
Never finding out the truth
Losing your family
Let everyone try their wildest ideas
Make the hard call and live with it
Protect the person next to you
Go first and expect others to follow

items.q: You get a day off. You…
options: Admit you'd like some recognition, then go out with friends
Clean, make tea and enjoy the silence
Hunt for a good meal, then nap
Read about something you know nothing about

items.q: In an argument you're most likely to…
options: Look for a compromise everyone can live with
Eat while everyone else argues
Refuse to back down, no matter what
Ask the question everyone's been avoiding
Stay close to the people who matter
Give your heart to the cause
Do it right, or don't do it
Be honest, even when it's awkward

eren.name: Eren Yeager
eren.body: You are fiercely driven and you hate being told what you can't do. When you believe in something, you go all in, and your passion pulls people along with you. That fire is your greatest strength; just make sure you still listen to the friends who have been beside you from the start.

mikasa.name: Mikasa Ackerman
mikasa.body: You are calm, capable and deeply loyal. You don't need to talk about how much you care; you show it by being there, every time. People feel safe with you. Remember that your own wishes matter too, not only the people you protect.

armin.name: Armin Arlert
armin.body: You are thoughtful, curious and smarter than you give yourself credit for. While others charge in, you look for the angle no one else saw, and your plans often save the day. Trust your mind, and believe your friends when they say they need you.

levi.name: Levi
levi.body: You are precise, skilled and calm when everything is falling apart. You keep high standards, keep your feelings private and keep your word. Under the cool exterior you care a great deal about your team. A cup of tea and a clean room are your idea of peace.

erwin.name: Erwin Smith
erwin.body: You are a born leader with a big vision. You can make hard decisions, inspire people to follow and keep everyone focused on the goal. Your dedication moves others; just remember to ask now and then what the cause costs you and the people you lead.

hange.name: Hange Zoë
hange.body: You are endlessly curious and bursting with enthusiasm. Where others see danger, you see something fascinating to study, and your energy makes even scary things feel like an adventure. Your open mind and kindness make you a brilliant scientist and a great friend, even if your notes are everywhere.

jean.name: Jean Kirstein
jean.body: You are honest, practical and you grow when it counts. You may grumble and say what everyone else is thinking, but you also understand people and stay level-headed when they don't. That makes you someone people trust, even when you'd rather stay out of it.

sasha.name: Sasha Blouse
sasha.body: You are warm, funny and full of life, and you are always thinking about the next meal. Under the jokes you are brave, quick on your feet and loyal to your friends. You bring lightness to hard times, and people love you for your big heart.
